A waking electroencephalogram is performed. An image of the record is shown during the hyperventilation maneuver. What epileptic syndrome corresponds?

Options:
opa. Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy.
opb. Lennox-Gastaut syndrome.
opc. Benign partial epilepsy of childhood with centrotemporal tips.
opd. Childhood absence epilepsy.
ope. West syndrome.
